original: §1 evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme | athāyuṣmān ānando yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ, upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte 'sthāt | ekānte sthita āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat |
analyzed: evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyām viharati sma jetavane nāthapiṇḍadasya ārāme atha āyuṣmān ānandaḥ yena bhagavān tena upasaṃkrāntaḥ upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte sthāt ekānte sthitaḥ āyuṣmān ānandaḥ bhagavantam etat avocat

original: §2 1) kiṃ bhadanta bhagavan kuśalamūlaṃ saṃmārjanapradānasya | 2) kiṃ maṇḍalakapradānasya | 3) kiṃ triśaraṇagamanaśikṣāpadānām | 4) kiṃ tathāgatānām añjalikarmaṇaḥ | 5) kiṃ bhadanta bhagavan kuśalamūlaṃ saṃsāre na kṣīyate, na paryādīyate, akṣayaṃ ca nirvāṇam upanayati | 6) kiṃ tathāgatabimbakaraṇāt |
analyzed: kim bhadanta bhagavan kuśala mūlam saṃmārjana pradānasya kim maṇḍalaka pradānasya kim triśaraṇa gamana śikṣā padānām kim tathāgatānām añjali karmaṇaḥ kim bhadanta bhagavan kuśala mūlam saṃsāre na kṣīyate na paryādīyate akṣayam ca nirvāṇam upanayati kim tathāgata bimba karaṇāt

original: §3 bhagavān āha | pañcānuśaṃsā ānanda saṃmārjanapradāne | katame pañca | yadutātmanaś cittaṃ prasīdati | pareṣāṃ ca cittaṃ prasīdati | devatāś cāttamanaso bhavati | prāsādikasaṃvartanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ bhavaty upacitam | kāyasya bhedāt sugatau svargaloke deveṣūpapadyate |
analyzed: bhagavān āha pañca anuśaṃsāḥ ānanda saṃmārjana pradāne katame pañca yat uta ātmanaḥ cittam prasīdati pareṣām ca cittam prasīdati devatāḥ ca ātta manasaḥ bhavati prāsādika saṃvartanīyam karma kṛtam bhavati upacitam kāyasya bhedāt sugatau svarga loke deveṣu upapadyate

original: §4 yaḥ kaścid ānanda prasannacittas tathāgatam uddiśya caturaśraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kurute, tasyāham ānandottarakuruṃ dvīpaṃ vadāmy aiśvaryādhipatyāya | kāyasya bhedāt trāyastriṃśeṣu deveṣūpapadyate |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda prasanna cittaḥ tathāgatam uddiśya caturaśram maṇḍalakam kurute tasya aham ānanda uttarakurum dvīpam vadāmi aiśvarya ādhipatyāya kāyasya bhedāt trāyastriṃśeṣu deveṣu upapadyate

original: §5 yaḥ kaścid ānanda prasannacitto buddhaṃ bhagavantam uddiśyārdhacandrākṛtiṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kurute, tasyāham ānanda pūrvavidehaṃ dvīpaṃ vadāmy aiśvaryādhipatyāya | kāyasya bhedād yāmeṣu deveṣūpapadyate |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda prasanna cittaḥ buddham bhagavantam uddiśya ardhacandra ākṛtim maṇḍalakam kurute tasya aham ānanda pūrvavideham dvīpam vadāmi aiśvarya ādhipatyāya kāyasya bhedāt yāmeṣu deveṣu upapadyate

original: §6 yaḥ kaścid ānanda tathāgatam uddiśya vartulaṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kurute, tasyāham ānandāparagodānīyaṃ dvīpaṃ vadāmy aiśvaryādhipatyāya | kāyasya bhedāt tuṣiteṣu deveṣūpapadyate |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda tathāgatam uddiśya vartulam maṇḍalakam kurute tasya aham ānandāparagodānīyam dvīpam vadāmi aiśvarya ādhipatyāya kāyasya bhedāt tuṣiteṣu deveṣu upapadyate

original: §7 yaḥ kaścid ānanda buddham uddiśya śakaṭākṛtiṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kurute, tasyāham ānanda jambūdvīpaṃ dvīpaṃ vadāmy aiśvaryādhipatyāya | kāyasya bhedān nirmāṇaratiṣu deveṣūpapadyate |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda buddham uddiśya śakaṭa ākṛtim maṇḍalakam kurute tasya aham ānanda jambūdvīpam dvīpam vadāmi aiśvarya ādhipatyāya kāyasya bhedāt nirmāṇaratiṣu deveṣu upapadyate

original: §8 yaḥ kaścid ānanda buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchati, dharmaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchati, saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchati, pañca śikṣāpadāni saṃgṛhya paripālayati, tasyāhaṃ kuśalamūlasyānandāprameyam asaṃkhyeyaṃ puṇyaṃ vadāmi | taṃ na śakyaṃ śrāvakapratyekabuddhaiḥ paryantam upagṛhītuṃ yāvannirvāṇaparyantaṃ vadāmi |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda buddham śaraṇam gacchati dharmam śaraṇam gacchati saṃgham śaraṇam gacchati pañca śikṣā padāni saṃgṛhya paripālayati tasya aham kuśala mūlasya ānanda aprameyam asaṃkhyeyam puṇyam vadāmi tam na śakyam śrāvaka pratyekabuddhaiḥ paryantam upagṛhītum yāvat nirvāṇa paryantam vadāmi

original: §9 atha bhagavān āyuṣmata ānandasya cetasā cittaṃ vijñāya raktakamalavimalāmalakomaladalamalāpagatakiṃśukāśokapallavatanutāmrapaṭṭasadṛśaviśālāyatajihvayā sarvaṃ mukham ācchādya yāvat keśaparyantam upādāyānandam uvāca | dṛṣṭā tvayānanda kasyacin mṛṣāvādinaḥ piśunavacasaḥ paruṣavacasaḥ saṃbhinnapralāpikasyaivaṃvirājā jihvā | no bhadanta |
analyzed: atha bhagavān āyuṣmataḥ ānandasya cetasā cittam vijñāya rakta kamala vimala amala komala dala mala apagata kiṃśuka aśoka pallava tanu tāmra paṭṭa sadṛśa viśāla āyata jihvayā sarvam mukham ācchādya yāvat keśa paryantam upādāya ānandam uvāca dṛṣṭā tvayā ānanda kasyacid mṛṣāvādinaḥ piśuna vacasaḥ paruṣa vacasaḥ saṃbhinna pralāpikasya evam virājā jihvā naḥ bhadanta

original: satyavādino hy ānanda tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāḥ |
analyzed: satya vādinaḥ hi ānanda tathāgatāḥ arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāḥ

original: §10 ye kecid ānanda prāñjaliṃ kṛtvā namo namas tasmai bhagavate tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāyeti namaskāraṃ kariṣyanti, te mayā sattvāḥ parigṛhītāḥ parinirvāpitāḥ | alpotsuko 'haṃ teṣāṃ sattvānām arthe | tat kasya hetoḥ | tathā hy ānanda tathāgatasya dharmadhātuḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ |
analyzed: ye kecid ānanda prāñjalim kṛtvā namaḥ namaḥ tasmai bhagavate tathāgatāya arhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya iti namaskāram kariṣyanti te mayā sattvāḥ parigṛhītāḥ parinirvāpitāḥ alpa utsukaḥ ham teṣām sattvānām arthe tat kasya hetoḥ tathā hi ānanda tathāgatasya dharmadhātuḥ su pratiṣṭhitaḥ

original: tasya supratiṣṭhitatvāt prāñjalikaraṇam api na praṇaśyati, prāg eva dānādikaraṇam | paśyānanda yad api tat puruṣasya svakaṃ bhaviṣyati darvīprakhyālanamātrakaṃ vā śarāvaprakhyālanamātrakaṃ vā kumbhīprakhyālanamātrakaṃ vā, yad api yady asāv evaṃcittaḥ pipīlikāsyandanikāyāṃ prakṣipet— ye 'tra saṃniśritāḥ prāṇinas te 'nena sukhitā bhavantv iti— tato
